title: Sindh Shops and Establishments Security Ordinance 2009

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Shops and Establishments Security Ordinance 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 2010
ORDINANCE I OF 2010
SINDH SHOPS AND
ESTABLISHMENTS
(SECURITY) ORDINANCE, 2009
An Ordinance to provide
security and protection to persons
and
property of the commercial, industrial establishments
and
shops in the Province
of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I,
8th January, 2010]
No.S.Legis:1(1)/2010, dated 8-1-2010.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:--
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to provide security and protection to persons and property of
the commercial, industrial establishments and shops in the Province of Sindh and to provide for
matters connected therewith or ancillary thereto;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is not in session
and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred
by clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the Governor of Sindh is pleased to make
and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Sindh Shops and
Establishments (Security) Ordinance, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

2.
Definitions.--In this Ordinance,
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,---
"commercial
establishment" means an establishment which carries on any business or any
work in connection with or incidental or ancillary to, a bank, a Money Changer
or a financial institution, stock exchange, brokerage houses, hotels
(multinational or otherwise) and includes any other establishment as the
Government may, by notification in the official Gazette declare to be
commercial establishment for the purpose of this Ordinance.
"employer"
means a person owning or having charge of the business of an establishment, and
includes an agent or manager or any
other person acting on behalf of such person in the general management or
control of such establishment;
"Government"
means the Government of Sindh;
"Industrial
establishment" means a workshop or an establishment, industrial unit and
includes such other class or classes of establishment as the Government may, by
notification in the official Gazette declare to be industrial establishment for
the purpose of this Ordinance.
"shop" means
any premises used wholly or in part for the wholesale or retail sale of
commodities or articles, either for cash or on credit, or where services are
rendered to customers, and includes an office, a store room, go down, warehouse
or place of work, whether in the same premises or otherwise mainly used in
connection with such trade or business;
"residential
hotels" means any premises in which a bona fide business is carried on for
the supply of dwelling accommodation and meals on payment of a sum of money by
a traveler or any other member of the public or class of the public and
includes a club;
"restaurants"
and "eating house" means any premises in which is carried on wholly
or principally the business of the supply of meals or refreshments to the
public or a class of the public for consumption on the premises; and
"Rules" means rules made under this Ordinance.

5. Penalties.--If the employer of any establishment contravenes
any order made under this Ordinance, shall be punished with imprisonment which
may extend to one month or with fine which may extend to fifty thousand rupees
or with both and if the offence continues, the establishment may be kept sealed
till such time the order is complied with.

Preamble.---Whereas

the commercial, industrial establishments and shops in the Province of Sindh and to provide for

And whereas the Provincial Assembly is not in session

6. Procedure.--(1) No prosecution shall be initiated against any
employer, for any offence under this Ordinance except by or with the previous
sanction of Government or other
officer or authority specially empowered by Government in this behalf.
(2) No court
inferior to that of a Magistrate of the First Class shall try an offence
punishable under this Ordinance or any rule made there under.
(3) No Court shall take cognizance of any offence under this
Ordinance except on a complaint made in writing within six months of the date
on which the offence was discovered.
sections.punishment: punishable under this Ordinance or any rule made there under.
